preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 100 inclusive.
The number of edges provided must be exactly n - 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v <= n and 1 <= u <= n and v != u for v, u in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect two distinct vertices within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n integers.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(x) < 1000000007 for x in stdout.split())
postconditions.description: Each integer in the output must be non-negative and less than 1000000007.

postconditions.expression: sum(int(x) for x in stdout.split()) == sum(1 for k in range(n) for _ in range(1))
postconditions.description: The sum of the output integers must equal the total number of labeled trees with n vertices.
